title: Operator Training and Simulation Program Manager
description:
MISO’s Operator Readiness & Development team equips control room operators and engineers with the advanced skills and scenario-based experience needed to perform safely, reliably, and confidently under both normal and abnormal grid conditions. We are seeking an **Operator Training & Simulation Program Manager**, a key leader and practitioner responsible for designing, delivering, and continuously improving high‑fidelity simulation training and member drills that directly support grid reliability across the MISO footprint.

**About the Role:**  
This role is responsible for leading MISO’s operator readiness simulation & drill program, developing and delivering realistic training experiences that strengthen readiness for normal, abnormal, and emergency operating scenarios. They will partner with operations, technology and industry partners to ensure simulation & drill activities support operational excellence and reliability.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Facilitate simulation training and operator/member drills (4 regular annual member drills per year) for control room operators and engineers, establishing a psychologically safe and operationally rigorous learning environment
* Lead the full lifecycle of simulation scenario design — from needs assessment to scripting, configuration, testing, and continuous refinement.
* Build and maintain a robust library of scenarios spanning normal operations, abnormal events, and emergency conditions.
* Collaborate with Operators, SMEs, engineering teams, and system support groups to ensure operational accuracy and alignment with MISO procedures and real‑world system conditions.
* Deliver individual and team‑based simulation sessions and large‑scale drills for operators, engineers, and members.
* Conduct effective pre‑briefs and psychologically safe, high‑quality debriefs that reinforce decision‑making and operational excellence.
* Adjust facilitation approaches based on participant experience—from trainees to seasoned operators.
